comment: madame is the sweetest professor I have ever met. she cares so much about us actually learning and enjoying the language rather than getting every small detail right. her class is so easy and she is the absolute best.

Dr. Ravaux-Kirkpatrick is so wonderful. She makes language-learning fun and pressure-free, unlike many of my past French teachers. Grading and homework can sometimes be a bit unclear, but she is very accessible outside of class to discuss things further. She also is SO knowledgeable--she is the professor to take for French Cinema!!

SI gentil! Madame is a very sweet and understanding lady who speaks beautiful French. She's flexible with deadlines if you ask, and will let you make corrections to your papers. However sometimes she's unclear about what work she wants handed in, so just ask her to clarify - a lot - she'll also bring the class food sometimes if you're lucky!!

Madame is the sweetest thing ever. She's incredibly patient and really wants you to understand the material she is teaching. Tests are very straightforward. If you pay attention in class and do the homework for practicing the grammar (typically only one or two pages out of a workbook) you should be successful in her class.

Madame is such a wonderful professor.  She is very understanding that many students in the class are at a low level of French, and she caters to that.  Always willing to take the extra time to help you understand a concept.  I definitely recommend taking Madame Ravaux-Kirkpatrick!

She is very nice( like a sweet French grandmother) and does not give a lot of homework. Very easy grader and gives easy tests, while keeping the class interesting. If you have to take 221, take her! I had a great time in her class!

A bit disorganized. She is usually very busy organizing the French Film festival. The work is a bit hard as its not written in a easy to read or sometimes even interesting style. However if you stick with it, it becomes really though provoking. Very friendly and is for the most part helpful if you go to see her.

I enjoyed her class and though it altogether wasn't difficult, there was work everyday. Keep up with the work, ask questions and be interested in her class and will probably get a grade. If you ask for help she will make time to help you. Very nice and not hard to please if you're a good student.
I really enjoyed her class. We always had great discussions. Shes not that hard at all. Very helpful and understanding. Very down to earth and realizes we are human.

Yes, a bit disorganized, but really knows her stuff, you just have to be willing to ask questions to get her to go deeper.  But if you want to just bs, you can get her to do that too.  She's so sweet and passionate about France and the language, so if you share her interests, take her classes.

Great class - she makes learning french easy and is really helpful when you have questions. As long as you try to learn, you will get on her good side. Her tests are predicatable and fair and it is possible to get an A if you do your work. Highly recommended
unorganised,gives a smile but hard grader, doesn't like people who know how to speak french AVOID

She is really nice.  For the final project, she offered to meet with me outside of class to help me with it.  She is a little disorganized and isn't clear about which assignments she wants you to hand in, but she always lets you make corrections on papers if she wasn't clear about something.

she legitimately wants you to learn and enjoy her class....grading is pretty lenient and if you talk to her about a grade she's really willing to consider/adjust it.  My accent got so much better listening to her- native French speaker

so sweet and understanding, very willing to discuss grading or assignments if you talk to her after class. class participation counts for a lot and she is a native speaker so you learn a ton. also in charge of the french film festival in the spring- the largest in america, awesome time!

Such a sweet lady!  Very relaxed class, doesn't really stress the little stuff (ie when you come in super late) Pretty easy, sometimes unclear on assignments- what you have to turn in and what you don't - but makes up for it by grading easy

Such a scatterbrain.  Missed class a lot.  Really unfair grader (different standards for all). Posted homework assignments like 5 hours before class. Totally unaware of whether anyone could understand her or not.  so unorganized
